## README

# Relations

Parent-child relations with cascade / restrict.

## What it shows

- Relation declarations between entities
- Delete behaviour (cascade vs restrict)

## Source

Feature entry point: `src/feature.ts`.

## Tests

Needs the Postgres from the repo root's `docker-compose.yml` (`docker compose up -d`); `TEST_DATABASE_URL` defaults to `postgresql://kumiko:kumiko@localhost:15432/kumiko_test`.

```bash
cd samples/recipes/relations
bun test
```

### src/__tests__/feature.integration.test.ts

```ts
// Relations Sample — Integration Test
// Proves: hasMany relations, cascade delete, restrict delete

import { afterAll, beforeAll, beforeEach, describe, expect, test } from "bun:test";
import type { SaveContext } from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-framework/engine";
import { TestUsers } from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-framework/seeding";
import { setupTestStack, type TestStack } from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-testing/stack";
import { relationsFeature } from "../feature";

let stack: TestStack;

const admin = TestUsers.admin;

beforeAll(async () => {
  stack = await setupTestStack({ features: [relationsFeature] });
});

afterAll(async () => {
  await stack.cleanup();
});

beforeEach(() => {
  stack.events.reset();
});

describe("restrict: team cannot be deleted with members", () => {
  test("delete team with members fails", async () => {
    const team = await stack.http.writeOk<SaveContext>(
      "org:write:team:create",
      { name: "Engineering" },
      admin,
    );
    await stack.http.writeOk<SaveContext>(
      "org:write:member:create",
      {
        name: "Alice",
        teamId: team.id,
      },
      admin,
    );

    const err = await stack.http.writeErr("org:write:team:delete", { id: team.id }, admin);
    expect(err).toMatchObject({ code: "conflict", details: { reason: "delete_restricted" } });
  });

  test("delete empty team succeeds", async () => {
    const team = await stack.http.writeOk<SaveContext>(
      "org:write:team:create",
      { name: "Empty Team" },
      admin,
    );

    await stack.http.writeOk("org:write:team:delete", { id: team.id }, admin);
  });
});

describe("cascade: deleting member removes tasks", () => {
  test("member's tasks are deleted when member is deleted", async () => {
    const team = await stack.http.writeOk<SaveContext>(
      "org:write:team:create",
      { name: "Cascade Team" },
      admin,
    );
    const member = await stack.http.writeOk<SaveContext>(
      "org:write:member:create",
      {
        name: "Bob",
        teamId: team.id,
      },
      admin,
    );

    const task1 = await stack.http.writeOk<SaveContext>(
      "org:write:task:create",
      {
        title: "Task A",
        memberId: member.id,
      },
      admin,
    );
    const task2 = await stack.http.writeOk<SaveContext>(
      "org:write:task:create",
      {
        title: "Task B",
        memberId: member.id,
      },
      admin,
    );

    await stack.http.writeOk("org:write:member:delete", { id: member.id }, admin);

    const detail1 = await stack.http.queryOk<null>(
      "org:query:task:detail",
      { id: task1.id },
      admin,
    );
    const detail2 = await stack.http.queryOk<null>(
      "org:query:task:detail",
      { id: task2.id },
      admin,
    );
    expect(detail1).toBeNull();
    expect(detail2).toBeNull();
  });
});
```

### src/feature.ts

```ts
import {
  createEntity,
  createReferenceField,
  createTextField,
  defineFeature,
} from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-framework/engine";

export const teamEntity = createEntity({
  name: "team",
  table: "read_sample_teams",
  fields: {
    name: createTextField({ personal: false, reason: "is_business_data", required: true }),
  },
});

export const memberEntity = createEntity({
  name: "member",
  table: "read_sample_members",
  fields: {
    name: createTextField({ personal: { of: "id" }, find: "none", required: true }),
    teamId: createReferenceField({
      entity: "team",
      personal: false,
      reason: "is_system_identifier",
      required: true,
    }),
    role: createTextField({ personal: false, reason: "is_business_data" }),
  },
});

export const taskEntity = createEntity({
  name: "task",
  table: "read_sample_member_tasks",
  fields: {
    title: createTextField({ personal: false, reason: "is_business_data", required: true }),
    memberId: createReferenceField({ entity: "member", personal: "ref", required: true }),
  },
});

const adminWrite = { access: { roles: ["Admin"] } } as const;
const openRead = {
  access: {
    openToAll: {
      reason: "any signed-in user may read a task by id; writes are still gated by adminWrite",
    },
  },
} as const;
const createOnly = {
  update: false,
  delete: false,
  restore: false,
  list: false,
  detail: false,
} as const;

const createAndDelete = { ...createOnly, delete: true } as const;

export const relationsFeature = defineFeature("org", (r) => {
  const team = r.entity(teamEntity);
  const member = r.entity(memberEntity);

  r.relation({
    entity: team,
    name: "members",
    type: "hasMany",
    target: "member",
    foreignKey: "teamId",
    onDelete: "restrict",
  });

  r.relation({
    entity: member,
    name: "tasks",
    type: "hasMany",
    target: "task",
    foreignKey: "memberId",
    onDelete: "cascade",
  });

  // onDelete runs automatically in the delete lifecycle: deleting a team is refused while
  // members exist, deleting a member removes its tasks.
  r.crud(teamEntity, {
    write: adminWrite,
    verbs: createAndDelete,
    registerEntity: false,
  });
  r.crud(memberEntity, {
    write: adminWrite,
    verbs: createAndDelete,
    registerEntity: false,
  });
  r.crud(taskEntity, {
    write: adminWrite,
    read: openRead,
    verbs: { ...createOnly, detail: true },
  });
});
```
